name: lem-topology-lefschetz-hopf
source: imports validated registry lemma proofs/lem-topology-lefschetz-hopf — Lefschetz-Hopf formula (maximal-simplex form): if f:X->X is a map of a finite polyhedron with a finite set of fixed points, each of which lies in a maximal simplex of X, then the Lefschetz number L(f) is the sum of the indices of all the fixed points of f.
